coord_space_note: Every x/y in this file is mosaic/PNG pixels (0..8192 × 0..4608), the same space as solids/ladders/lifts in s2_collision.json. Runtime multiplies by scale (currently 2) to get world pixels (16384 × 9216). Do not mix in pre-scaled world coordinates — that is how spawn used to sit at half the intended place. Player and guard origins are sprite top-left (48×56). Pickup, sabotage and exit origins are Area2D centres.
